column7: This is in my opinion the best place to live when just moving to Dallas and starting the GLP. Main pro is that you can walk to work! I can leave my apartment at 8:45 and be at my desk on time. Other pros are that the units are super nice and updated, maintenance is really fast, parking is super easy and convenient (and free), pricing is not too crazy (compared to Dallas) and the location is awesome. Walkable to so many restaurants and coffee shops and easy access to katy trail. The pool space is great, gym is alright, nothing special. The biggest con is the elevators, they are broken often. The building is only 5 floors so walking up stairs is not the end of the world but definitely inconvenient. Overall I recommend, you can't beat the convenience of the location.
column8: Walkable to work, dining, and Katy Trail. Updated units, fast maintenance, free parking, and a great pool; the gym is basic and elevators often break.

column7:
Honestly, I’m loving it so far! It’s brand new and right outside of downtown right off the expressway, so pretty much everything is only 10 to 15 minutes away.

The deal was crazy good too. I got 10 weeks free, which made it way more affordable than other places nearby, especially for what you get.

The place itself is super clean and modern: all hardwood, electric stove, smart oven, massive washer and dryer, LED mirrors in the bathroom, and balcony access. Plus the amenities are awesome (two big pools, a full two-story gym, and they host a ton of resident events).

Really solid all around!
column8: New, modern units with large appliances, two pools, a two-story gym, and resident events. Convenient expressway access; one resident received 10 weeks free at move-in.
